messages:
ana: Noticed dashboards are slower today after the rollout. small charts delay ~300ms and large ones sometimes fail to hydrate.
tom: hitting it too. flamegraphs point to heavy parse time from a newly inlined helper in chart-core. feels like a bundling regression.
li: which helper? we had a tiny polyfill added last week. maybe it pulled a bunch of locale code by accident.
ana: (typo) ana: it’s `formatNumberLocale` that landed as a direct import instead of dynamic. bundle report shows `locales/*` included.
deploy-bot: deploy "web-client@2026.03.22-number-format-fix" completed 2026-03-22T09:05:00Z (canary 20%).
tom: if parse is blocking, router prefetches get delayed and retry logic increases server requests. quotas might get hit.
qa-bot: saw increased 429s in API logs correlated with canary traffic.
li: simple rollback option: revert the direct import and reintroduce dynamic import with chunk name `locales`. low risk.
ana: (ana) workaround idea: lazy-load a minimal formatter that only includes en-US for early paint then load full locales async. that keeps capture of early telemetry but prevents big parse.
tom: we also should reduce prefetch parallelism temporarily. change feature flag `prefetch.maxParallel=2`.
infra: I can flip the flag for prod canary groups.
li: follow-ups: 1) hotfix PR to dynamic import locales 2) infra reduces prefetch concurrency 3) add CI assertion to ensure no locale wildcard is bundled into main chart chunk (>50KB gz) 4) doc note for product on telemetry tradeoffs.
ana: I'll open the hotfix now.
ana: PR 548 branch created and CI running.
ana: thanks, flipping canary to 0% while we validate.
deploy-bot: canary scale set to 0% per request.
qa-bot: preliminary staging checks show main-thread parse time down ~280ms after hotfix branch.
nana: merging hotfix after CI green. will follow up with small RFC about when early-init is acceptable for telemetry and critical-formatting helpers.
li: good. also add bundle-diff check to pre-merge job so this doesn't slip again.
nana: agreed. closing loop once merged. :shipit:
